title: Duration parser and formatter with thirteen stated requirements

requirements.text: parse_duration converts w, d, h, m, s components and their combinations to seconds
Whitespace is allowed around the string and between components, not between a number and its unit
A bare integer string means seconds; otherwise every component needs a unit
Units must be in descending order and appear at most once
Invalid input raises ValueError whose message contains the offending input
A non-str argument to parse_duration raises TypeError
format_duration returns the canonical compact form; 0 gives 0s
format_duration rejects negatives with ValueError and non-int (including bool and float) with TypeError
parse(format(parse(x))) equals parse(x) for valid x
test_duration.py has at least 12 unittest methods and they pass
Standard library only, and no files other than duration.py and test_duration.py
